import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-original-paid-exercise/director-candidate')
archive = base64.b64decode(''.join((root / 'sqlite-reconciliation.zip.b64').read_text().split()), validate=True)
archive_hash = hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest()
assert archive_hash == '76bdf9b059b77ee575f4c3fed3787059a07a0b2bf78e8babb4bee282d30bf08c', archive_hash
prior = json.loads((root / 'execution.json').read_text())
expected_members = prior['members']
trials = {}
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as package, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    work = pathlib.Path(tmp)
    assert sorted(package.namelist()) == sorted(expected_members)
    for name, info in expected_members.items():
        content = package.read(name)
        assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == info['sha256'], name
        (work / name).write_bytes(content)
    original = (work / 'solution.sql').read_text().strip().removesuffix(';')
    wrapped = 'WITH reconciled(id, ordered, received) AS (\n' + original + '\n)\n'
    variants = {
        'equivalent': 'SELECT id, ordered, received FROM reconciled ORDER BY id;',
        'wrong_total': 'SELECT id, ordered, received + 1 FROM reconciled ORDER BY id;',
        'missing_row': 'SELECT id, ordered, received FROM reconciled WHERE id <> 2 ORDER BY id;'
    }
    for name, sql in variants.items():
        (work / (name + '.sql')).write_text(wrapped + sql, encoding='utf-8')
    expectations = {'solution': (0, [(1, 8, 5), (2, 4, 0), (3, 3, 3)]), 'equivalent': (0, [(1, 8, 5), (2, 4, 0), (3, 3, 3)]), 'wrong_total': (1, [(1, 8, 6), (2, 4, 1), (3, 3, 4)]), 'missing_row': (1, [(1, 8, 5), (3, 3, 3)])}
    for name, (expected_exit, expected_rows) in expectations.items():
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'check.py', name + '.sql'], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        passed = result.returncode == expected_exit and ('Observed ' + repr(expected_rows)) in result.stdout and not result.stderr
        trials[name] = {'expected_exit': expected_exit, 'actual_exit': result.returncode, 'expected_observed_rows': expected_rows, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'pass': passed}
report = {'archive_sha256': archive_hash, 'member_hashes_verified': sorted(expected_members), 'scope': 'Fictional offline learner controls on the exact private archive. The equivalent query wraps the supplied solution and checks acceptance of a different SQL expression with the same result. These controls do not establish correctness on arbitrary learner datasets.', 'all_pass': all(trial['pass'] for trial in trials.values()), 'trials': trials}
encoded = json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n'
(root / 'learner-checker-controls.json').write_text(encoded, encoding='utf-8')
print(encoded)

description: The original SQLite exercise has a verified archive hash and a clean run in which the starter query failed and the supplied solution passed. The next check will establish whether the learner can submit an equivalent solution and whether the checker catches wrong totals and missing rows. Seller authorization is pending for this archive. That affects distribution and checkout activation while offline testing can proceed. The catalogue update remains subject to independent approval of its exact digest.
